notes.title: Playtest v1.3 Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/8119bde6b6f726ea7be5114d8092e584bf8ca5cd.png"][/img]Added a minimap UI to dungeons, and increased object density to make exploration more strategic and engaging.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/80e281b43537f5b15ba751d74ce4235cd729a849.png"][/img]Enhanced interactions with Veronica, including new animations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added various tutorials and guide texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of interactive objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added progress display when sleeping.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new background art for dungeons.[/p][/*][*][p]Overall balancing adjustments.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Playtest v1.2 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/04eb480270b7c884364c31d964137bd736f3574a.png[/img]
You can now see the cooldown of blessings at the top-left corner. Enjoy more strategic combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/3e51b1e8f13b5b9e95e0396616b095efc2561a57.png[/img]
Talk to the parrot to receive various pieces of advice. But don’t expect it to speak endlessly.

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Dungeon balance has been improved.
[*] The tutorial area has been updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/30354e46e908a8ce2e4717bc0ff708483cc19954.png[/img]
Monsters now burst with various fluids when hit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/1317381148adf4a4789ab4a36dab238a2dc3af84.png[/img]
The cathedral now glows gently under the moonlight during nighttime.


[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved UI navigation for easier selection and cancellation
[*] Intro dialogue can now be skipped from the second playthrough onward
[*] Sword swings now connect more reliably with enemies
[*] Increased English text speed slightly
[/list]

notes.title: Devil Meat Playtest Has Begun!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602648/08b7318a5696832054124912fe925a16451089f1.png[/img]
[h3]Welcome to the Devil Meat Playtest[/h3]
We’re excited to announce the very first release of the Devil Meat Playtest(version 1.0)

This build is designed to gather feedback during the early stage of development.
You can start playing right away by signing up through the Devil Meat Steam store page.

[h3]How to Leave Feedback[/h3]
[list]
[*]We welcome all feedback, including bugs, difficulty issues, pacing, or anything else you notice!
[*]Please leave your comments in the discussion section or via the Steam Community Hub:
🔗 https://steamcommunity.com/app/3683900/
[/list]
Thank you so much!!
